product.ta-des.summary: The TA DES let DATEV practices record data on cassette while offline from the data centre.
product.ta-des.history: Triumph-Adler offered it to DATEV members with low accounting volumes. The October 1979 manual documents a workstation that recorded data on cassette for later processing.
product.ta-des.technical.configuration: The cassette carried data for later processing. The brochure shows a configuration with 3 KiB of RAM and an ECMA 34 cassette.
product.ta-des.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-des.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
